# International Department, Central Committee of C.P.C (中共中央对外联络部)

The cited URL is the homepage of the International Department of the CPC Central Committee (idcpc.gov.cn), the official primary source. The homepage itself is a rotating news page (People's Daily items on holiday economy and China-Africa zero tariffs) and does not carry the 20th Congress report body. The load-bearing claim (20th Congress reaffirmed the two-step strategy as the Party's central task) is confirmed by the official full text of the 20th Congress report, reproduced below.

## Cited claim (traced to the official 20th Congress report)
The 20th National Congress of the CPC (2022) reaffirmed the "two-step" strategy as the Party's central task.

## Official 20th Congress report text (authoritative origin)
Source: Full text of the report to the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China (chinadaily.com.cn, 2022-10-25; also gov.cn and CSIS translation).

"From this day forward, the central task of the Communist Party of China will be to lead the Chinese people of all ethnic groups in a concerted effort to realize the Second Centenary Goal of building China into a great modern socialist country in all respects and to advance the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation on all fronts through a Chinese path to modernization."

"To build China into a great modern socialist country in all respects, we have adopted a two-step strategic plan:
- Basically realize socialist modernization from 2020 through 2035
- Build China into a great modern socialist country that is prosperous, strong, democratic, culturally advanced, harmonious, and beautiful from 2035 through the middle of this century"

China's overall development objectives for the year 2035 include: significantly increase economic strength, scientific and technological capabilities, and composite national strength; substantially grow per capita GDP to be on par with a mid-level developed country; join the ranks of the world's most innovative countries, with great self-reliance and strength in science and technology; become a leading country in education, science and technology, talent, culture, sports, and health; substantially grow the middle-income group as a share of the total population; and achieve basic modernization of national defense and the armed forces.
